title: docs: three pages link the deployment section index under labels that name neither of its two lifecycles
body:
Restart-when: any PR touches content/docs/ui/setup-app.mdx, content/docs/automation/hook-bodies.mdx or content/docs/kernel/index.mdx (relabel rides as a declared rider)

Observation, not a defect with a repro. Found while re-pointing the deployment section index in #8913 (PR #8983); recorded rather than fixed there, because these three labels are no more wrong after that rewrite than before it, and sweeping them would have widened that PR's surface without evidence forcing it.

Three pages outside the deployment section link `/docs/deployment` under labels that name neither the platform-runtime lifecycle nor the metadata-app one:

| File | Line | Current label |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `content/docs/ui/setup-app.mdx` | 125 | `[Cloud Deployment](/docs/deployment)` — "how Setup behaves in cloud mode" |
| `content/docs/automation/hook-bodies.mdx` | 345 | `[Cloud Deployment](/docs/deployment)` — "how artifacts travel from Studio to objectos" |
| `content/docs/kernel/index.mdx` | 45 | `[Deployment & Operations](/docs/deployment)` |

Line numbers are as of `origin/main` at `8b9eba51b`.

Why it is worth recording:

- "Cloud Deployment" was already imprecise — the page is not cloud-specific, and cloud is one venue inside the platform-runtime half. A reader following that label from the UI or automation docs expects a cloud page and gets a two-lifecycle fork.
- `kernel/index.mdx` uses the **section** title (`Deployment & Operations`, from `content/docs/deployment/meta.json`) as the label for the **page**, whose title is now `Deployment Overview`. Both strings exist in the nav, which makes the mismatch harder to notice than a plain stale name.

None of this breaks a gate: `check:doc-anchors` only judges `#fragment` targets, and lychee only judges that the file resolves. Link *labels* have no owner, which is why this class drifts silently.

Suggested fix if it is worth a card: relabel all three to the page's own title, and give the two "Cloud Deployment" sites a trailing clause that says which half the reader is being sent to. Small and mechanical; the judgement call is whether a label-only sweep earns a PR of its own.
